subject.title: feat: expose rawBody on user messages in plugin hook events

question: Should plugin hook events expose provenance-gated command-clean user text, and should that public field remain named `rawBody`?
rationale: Both literal transport text and command-normalized clean text are implementable, but choosing the permanent plugin API meaning, naming, and acceptable cross-runtime steer semantics requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor clean-user text
options.body: Keep the capability but rename or tighten the public wording so plugins cannot mistake it for literal transport `RawBody`.

options.title: Expose literal RawBody
options.body: Keep the `rawBody` name but source it strictly from the channel's literal `RawBody`, including mention and transport-level text.

options.title: Decline the new field
options.body: Keep the existing hook surface and defer clean-input access to a future maintainer-designed trusted inbound-body contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor clean-user text
recommendation.body: Keep the capability but rename or tighten the public wording so plugins cannot mistake it for literal transport `RawBody`.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest concrete history signal is the recent refactor that established the current public hook type and shared harness surfaces.
